summary:
可口可樂EPS超預期2.7%，季度獲利穩健達標，品牌力支撑淡季表現。
• EPS 0.58美元，超出預期0.56美元，超預期幅度2.69%
• 營收118.2億美元，反映品牌組合在淡季的穩定貢獻
• 獲利穩健達標，輕資產模式維持高利潤率
• 全球佈局分散單一市場與匯率風險
ai_view:
訊號穩健：EPS溫和超預期，顯示可口可樂在淡季仍維持穩定獲利，品牌力與輕資產模式提供韌性。短期股價中性偏多，營收年增率未揭露使成長判讀有限。中期重點在定價策略延續性與無糖、新興品類擴張。追蹤指標：有機營收價/量拆分、各區域銷量、匯率影響、營業利潤率、現金流與股息政策。

需留意：營收年增率未揭露，成長動能須結合趨勢判讀；美元走強對海外營收換算的匯率壓力；含糖飲料健康疑慮的長期結構性逆風

summary_en:
Coca-Cola beat EPS by 2.7%, delivering steady off-season earnings backed by brand strength.
• EPS of $0.58 beat the $0.56 estimate by 2.69%
• Revenue of $11.82B reflects stable off-season contribution from the brand portfolio
• Steady earnings delivery, with the asset-light model sustaining high margins
• Global footprint diversifies single-market and FX risk

ai_view_en:
Signal is steady: a modest EPS beat shows Coca-Cola maintaining stable earnings in the off-season, with brand power and the asset-light model providing resilience. Near-term neutral-to-positive, though undisclosed YoY limits growth reads. Mid-term the focus is pricing-strategy durability and zero-sugar/new-category expansion. Track: price/volume split in organic revenue, regional volumes, FX impact, operating margin, cash flow and dividend policy.

Watch：Revenue YoY not disclosed, so momentum must be read against the trend; A stronger dollar pressures translation of overseas revenue; Health concerns over sugary drinks are a long-term structural headwind
beat_or_miss: 符合預期 / EPS超預期2.69%屬溫和達標（營收年增率未揭露）。
